changelog:
- Initial release: control AIMP music player via Windows command-line switches.
- Supports play, pause, stop, next, previous, and play/pause toggle.
- No external dependencies required; only AIMP and Windows terminal needed.
- Includes example commands, reference table, and troubleshooting tips.
- Commands work in real-time as long as AIMP is running.
summary: Control AIMP music player via native command-line switches (play, pause, stop, next, prev).
